question: Entomophily pollination occurs with the help of:
solution:
Correct answer is __**Insects.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Entomophily or insect pollination is a form of pollination by which **pollen of plants, especially but not only of flowering plants, is distributed by insects.**
 
• In entomophily, **insects are the most common pollinators**.
 
• The flowers give rise to **nectar and fragrance** with bright colours attract the insects.
 
• The most usual insect pollinators are – **moths, flies, butterflies, wasp, bees, beetles etc. **
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c647eda11a5ed82b707de89cd0ac6acc1bcbf5e6f344eb151afde129ad59b21a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Pollination is **the act of transferring pollen grains from the male anther of a flower to the female stigma**.
 
• **When pollen is transported by wind, this is called anemophily**.
 
• Water pollinated plants are aquatic. **Pollen floats on the water's surface drifting until it contacts flowers**.
